install_id.description: Random persistent identifier scoped to one HERMES_HOME.

dimensions.description: v3 rows carry call_role/error_class/outcome (and ttft_bucket from the decision-data build); rows counted by an older build carry only model/provider.
skill_name is a bundled/optional skill name or 'custom'; absent on rows counted before it existed.

vocabulary_identifier.description: Closed vocabulary owned by hermes_cli/observability/shared_metrics_contract.py (derived from in-repo registries); values outside it are never emitted.

dimensions.description: The five decision-data fields are absent on snapshots counted before they existed. The six version-lag/channel/hardware fields are absent on snapshots counted before they existed.
v5 engagement: message/model-call/tool-call buckets are optional so session rows recorded before them still validate; one row per conversation (compression-rotated segments merged).
value is the summed token count for the day, not an event count.

catalog_identifier.description: A public name Nous publishes (slash-command registry, bundled/optional skills, optional-mcps/ and plugin-catalog/ entries, shipped locales), or the placeholder custom/plugin/skill/unknown/other.

dimensions.description: One per tool call a model emitted; issue=none when clean, so issue rates have a denominator.
A user friction action attributed to the model that produced the turn.
One per closed session: the fullest primary-model context it reached.
One per patch/write_file tool call; match_strategy is the fuzzy-match strategy that landed an applied patch (the loosest one for a multi-hunk V4A patch), none otherwise.

At most once per turn per (signal, detector): repeated_tool_call = a warning the call still ran with, loop_detected = the harness blocked or halted, iteration_cap = the turn spent its iteration budget.
One per failed tool call: what the model's next tool call did (the next call to the same tool, else its first call), or no_tool_call / gave_up when the turn ended without one.
One per foreground terminal command that reached an exit status; command_kind comes from a fixed table of first program words, never the command text.
One per primary model response; issue=none when the response is usable, so issue rates have a denominator.
One per user turn the user saw end: what it cost (prompt + completion tokens over its primary calls) and how much work it took.
One per user turn thrown away by an interrupt, /retry or /undo, with the tokens it had spent.
One per tool result: whether Hermes spilled or truncated it (per-result cap or per-turn budget), by raw size.
One per closed interactive conversation: how many tools it had enabled and the estimated tokens their definitions cost per request.
One per enabled shipped toolset per closed interactive conversation (MCP/plugin/user toolsets read custom): whether any of its tools ran.
A prompt-cache break mid-conversation: a cause Hermes knows (compression is expected), or a cold provider read after a warm one on the same route.

v5 engagement: one per closed UTC day with activity: total active time (inter-interaction gaps capped at 5 minutes), surfaces used, and the model that served most attended turns (none when no attended turn). active_profile_count_bucket: distinct profiles of the host with a user turn that day, reported only on the root (default) profile's row; other profiles' rows carry 0.
v5 engagement: one per surface used on a closed UTC day, with that surface's active time.
v5 engagement: one per /model switch away from a model that served turns in the conversation, with how many.

long_size_bucket.description: v5 engagement: size_bucket with a longer tail for conversation volume.

dimensions.description: A model called a tool Hermes ships that this session did not enable (background reviews and delegated children excluded).
One per provider-setup flow transition; failure_class is none unless event=failed. Custom endpoints read custom.
Emitted once per feature per install, at its first real use; the bucket is the owning profile's age then.

A user turned off something Hermes ships on (or removed a shipped skill), or turned it back on. name is a shipped toolset / bundled or catalog skill or plugin / DEFAULT_CONFIG key path (never a value), else custom. At most once per (kind, name, event) per day.
